style: 1990s retro Japanese anime OVA style, cel-shaded, hand-painted background, dramatic cinematic lighting, deep shadows, rich warm colors, subtle film grain, epic Indian mythology, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

rama.desc: Prince Rama: young man about 25, blue-tinged dark skin, calm compassionate eyes, long black hair tied up, golden crown, yellow silk dhoti, gold armlets, great bow

dasharatha.desc: King Dasharatha: elderly king about 60, fair skin, white beard and moustache, tall jeweled golden crown, red and gold royal robes, pearl necklaces

vasishtha.desc: Sage Vasishtha: very old sage, long white beard and white hair tied in a top knot, saffron robe, rudraksha beads, wooden staff, calm wise face

kausalya.desc: a gentle Indian queen of about 40 with a kind face, wearing a modest cream and gold silk sari covering her shoulders, a small golden crown and a long black braid

kaikeyi.desc: a proud Indian queen of about 35 with sharp eyes, wearing a modest deep red silk sari with gold border covering her shoulders, heavy gold jewelry and a tall crown

sumitra.desc: Queen Sumitra: serene queen about 38, brown skin, peaceful face, green silk sari with gold border, small golden crown

rama_forest.desc: Rama in forest exile: young man about 25, blue-tinged dark skin, calm compassionate eyes, long black hair tied up in a sage's matted top knot, no crown, simple ochre bark-cloth garment and cloth over one shoulder, wooden beads, great bow and quiver

sita.desc: Princess Sita: graceful young woman about 20, warm golden-brown skin, large gentle eyes, long black hair in a braid with a red bindi, simple elegant yellow-ochre sari with a red border covering her shoulders, a few gold ornaments

lakshmana.desc: Lakshmana: young man about 23, fair skin, alert fierce eyes, black hair tied in a top knot, simple saffron garment and cloth over one shoulder, bow and quiver, protective stance

hanuman.desc: Hanuman: powerful divine vanara with a gentle monkey face, golden-orange fur, red-orange face, long tail, golden crown and earrings, red dhoti, carrying a golden mace, devoted kind eyes

ravana.desc: Ravana: imposing demon king with ten crowned heads in a row, dark brown skin, thick black moustache, fierce eyes, heavy gold armor and jewels, deep crimson and black royal robes, twenty arms only when fighting

bharata.desc: Bharata: young prince about 22, dark wheat skin, sorrowful earnest eyes, black hair, simple white garment with a thin gold border, no crown, tilak on forehead

sugriva.desc: Sugriva: vanara monkey king, brown-gold fur, anxious but noble monkey face, golden crown, green and gold dhoti, gold armlets, long tail

angada.desc: Angada: young vanara prince, reddish-brown fur, bold confident monkey face, small golden crown, blue and gold dhoti, armlets, long tail

vibhishana.desc: Vibhishana: dignified rakshasa nobleman, dark skin, kind wise eyes, neat beard, single head, white and gold robes, simple crown, prayer beads

indrajit.desc: Indrajit: young demon prince warrior, dark skin, cruel handsome face, black armor with gold trim, tall dark crown, glowing bow, dark cape

maricha.desc: Maricha: lean demon with grey skin, sunken frightened eyes, long tangled hair, tusks, ragged dark hermit clothes

janaka.desc: King Janaka: serene sage-king about 55, wheat skin, grey beard, wise kind eyes, simple white and gold robes, small golden crown

vishwamitra.desc: Sage Vishwamitra: stern powerful old sage, lean muscular body, long grey beard and matted grey hair in a top knot, fierce eyes, saffron robe, deerskin over one shoulder, wooden staff

surpanakha.desc: Surpanakha: tall rakshasi demoness, dark grey-green skin, wild copper hair, long claws, glowing angry eyes, tattered dark red garments, fully clothed

jambavan.desc: Jambavan: ancient wise bear king, huge dark brown bear standing upright, long white chin fur, gentle old eyes, golden crown and necklace, cloth sash
